chapters.1.meaning: Hannah speaks from deep grief. She brings that grief to God in prayer.
chapters.2.meaning: Hannah sings about God helping poor and weak people. Eli's sons instead use power for themselves.
chapters.2.lds: The older Church manual connects Hannah's song with Jesus Christ.
chapters.3.meaning: Samuel learns to listen and speak a hard message. Eli must hear judgment against his family.
chapters.6.meaning: The people of Beth Shemesh welcome the ark. Joy turns to fear after people die.
chapters.12.meaning: Israel now has a king. Both king and people must still listen to God.
chapters.14.meaning: Saul's oath nearly costs Jonathan his life. The soldiers protect the man who helped them win.
chapters.16.meaning: God tells Samuel to look beyond a person's size. David later helps Saul through music.
chapters.17.meaning: David trusts God and uses skills learned as a shepherd. He faces a soldier others fear.
chapters.19.lds: The older Church manual compares Samuel's group of prophets with later Church schools.
chapters.22.lds: The older Church manual condemns Saul's attack on the priests.
chapters.23.meaning: David seeks God's guidance as danger changes. Jonathan visits him and strengthens his trust.
chapters.24.meaning: David spares Saul but keeps his distance. His restraint does not end Saul's pursuit.
chapters.24.lds: Come, Follow Me invites readers to study David's self-control and forgiveness.
chapters.27.meaning: Achish trusts David's false reports. People in the raided towns pay for David's secret.
chapters.1.lds: The Church lesson studies Hannah's prayer during grief and her trust in God.
chapters.16.lds: The Church lesson asks readers to consider a person's heart instead of outward appearance.
people.hannah.meaning: She tells God about her grief, makes a promise, and sings praise after Samuel's birth.
people.elkanah.meaning: He tries to comfort Hannah during her grief. He also supports her promise about Samuel.
people.hophni.meaning: He takes offerings by force and abuses his priestly duties. He dies when the ark is captured.
people.man-of-god.meaning: He warns Eli that his family's priestly service will end.
people.ichabod-mother.meaning: She names her child while grieving family deaths and the capture of the ark.
people.joel-samuel.meaning: Samuel's son takes bribes and twists justice. His conduct helps prompt the demand for a king.
people.jonathan-armor-bearer.meaning: He follows Jonathan into danger and helps him attack the Philistine post.
people.ahijah-priest.meaning: He serves as priest with Saul's army during the conflict with the Philistines.
people.michal.meaning: She loves David and helps him escape Saul. Saul later gives her to another husband.
people.goliath.meaning: His challenge leaves Israel's soldiers afraid. David faces him with a sling.
people.abigail.meaning: She brings food and speaks to David. Her action stops his plan to kill Nabal's household.
people.nabal.meaning: He refuses David's request for food. Abigail acts quickly to prevent an attack on their household.
people.endor-medium.meaning: Saul asks her to call up Samuel. She fears Saul's ban but later gives him food.
chapters.4.lds: The Church lesson examines trust in the ark. Why does carrying the ark fail to protect the army?
